optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in Go billing services, design documentation, on-call participation, and CI improvements, but do not conclusively prove ownership of the extraction design and rollout plan.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess ownership claim and other gaps.

evidence.text: Backend engineer at Lumenfold, a scheduling-software company, from 2021 to 2024, building the invoice-generation and proration services in Go.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of Go service development.

evidence.text: Wrote two design documents, 'Retry policy for payment webhooks' and 'Idempotency keys for invoice creation'; the team's tech lead reviewed and approved both.
evidence.notes: Explicit design document authorship and review.

evidence.text: Under an architecture diagram copied from the design document sits a 'Kudos' panel of peer comments: 'basically drove the whole extraction', 'owned the rollout and every design call' and 'the technical lead in all but name'.
evidence.notes: Peer comments suggest lead role but not confirmed.

missingEvidence: Ownership of design decisions and rollout plan not established; staff engineer wrote design and rollout plan per note.

evidence.text: On the weekly on-call rotation; wrote the incident review for a 2023 duplicate-charge incident with the timeline, contributing causes and four follow-up actions.
evidence.notes: Direct on-call participation and incident review.

evidence.text: Added contract tests for the invoicing API and set up a quarantine stage in the CI pipeline for unstable test suites.
